maddeler.e:
أتزايد (form VI)
# أَتَزَايَدُ (ʔatazāyadu) /ʔa.ta.zaː.ja.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَزَايَدَ (tazāyada)
# أَتَزَايَدَ (ʔatazāyada) /ʔa.ta.zaː.ja.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَزَايَدَ (tazāyada)
# أَتَزَايَدْ (ʔatazāyad) /ʔa.ta.zaː.jad/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَزَايَدَ (tazāyada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
